jobs.title: Technical Support Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. About the Role As a Technical Support Engineering Intern, you won't be grabbing coffee or shadowing others. Our interns are at the forefront of our team, tackling real-world challenges alongside our full-time engineers. Based at our San Mateo HQ, you'll work with cutting-edge, cloud-managed IoT technology, helping our enterprise clients with everything from troubleshooting to system design. This internship is your chance to make a real impact, build valuable technical skills, and jumpstart your career in a dynamic, high-tech environment. What You'll Do Hands-on Troubleshooting: Dive into complex network, hardware, and software problems on Verkada's platform Level Up Fast: Become the go-to expert customers trust for smart system design and integration advice Communicate with Impact: Translate heavy technical concepts into clear, sharp advice on phone calls, live chat, and emails Own It, End to End: Take full ownership of customer issues from "we have a problem" to "problem solved" Team Up with Tech Leaders: Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams to test new gear and hunt down bugs before anyone else Share Knowledge: Write Knowledge Base content that helps thousands of users What You Bring Available for a full-time (40 hours per week) in-person internship for Summer 2027 in San Mateo, CA A third or fourth-year student in a Bachelor's degree program from an accredited university, with a focus on a related technical field like Networking, Telecommunications, Systems Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Cybersecurity You have coursework experience with computer networking, Linux, and computer systems You're a problem-solver with a keen eye for detail You can clearly and confidently communicate complex technical information You thrive in a team environment Industry certifications (like CCNP, CCNA, or Network+) are a bonus, but not required! Intern Perks & Benefits At Verkada, we believe that internships should be as rewarding, supportive, and fun as they are impactful! That’s why we’re committed to providing a world-class experience that supports both your personal well-being and professional growth. Here are just a few of the perks and benefits you can expect as a Verkada Technical Support Engineering intern: Monthly housing stipend for those relocating to the area, in addition to a competitive hourly wage Daily lunch catered onsite, complimentary barista-made drinks, and fully stocked snacks to keep you fueled Intern-exclusive events and mixers, allowing you to connect with other interns across different teams Cross-functional collaboration opportunities, giving you real exposure to how teams work together Meetings with company executives so you can hear directly from leaders and gain insight into building a successful career 333 program: you can go out with your fellow interns after work and expense $30 off a meal Friendly tournaments involving Super Smash Bros, Magic, and other games Intern exclusive bingo cards that allow you to explore the Bay Area and win fun swag! And more! From team-building activities to mentorship opportunities, we’re here to support your growth every step of the way Don't just take it from us, hear directly from some of our current and past interns on their experience: “A benefit of being a TSE at Verkada is about being a part of a fast-growing company. You learn about the latest products deeply and learn how to effectively communicate what you have learned in an easy-to-understand way for customers: ‘If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.’ Albert Einstein” - Daniel, TSE Intern, London “After training (which feels a lot like university lectures) you spend time in queue, which is basically being on-call for the next chat/call/email that comes in. When a customer needs something, whether that’s information about a product, how to set up that product, or that product having a bit of a moment, you are the one who gets to be the source of truth for that person. Being able to communicate this to them in a reasonable amount of time is paramount to doing well in this role” - Tedrick, TSE Intern, HQ “This internship has given me a lot to think about in terms of career goals. I would say in particular this internship is a great way to build your connections for the Silicon Valley area if your goal is to work in the Tech space. It’s also given me a unique perspective and understanding of enterprise equipment. It serves as a great launching point for your career.” - Thomas, TSE Intern, HQ Additional Information We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa. Pay Disclosure At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity . This estimate can vary based on the factors described above, so the actual starting base pay may be above or below this range. Base pay is also just one component of Verkada’s total rewards package. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Estimated Hourly Pay Range $30 — $33 USD Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Who We Are Vermeer equips customers doing important work around the world. We are global, driven by innovation and growing. The equipment we make manages natural resources, connects people and feeds and fuels communities. We live out a caring culture, we demonstrate agility, we keep a focus on customers and are stewards of our resources. These beliefs drive our culture, determine how we treat others and steer our business. Work Shift 1 - First Shift Job Summary Are you energized by solving problems and improving how things are made? As a Manufacturing Engineer Intern at Vermeer, you’ll support real-world projects that enhance production processes and drive operational excellence. This internship offers hands-on experience in lean manufacturing, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration—preparing you for a full-time engineering role upon graduation. What You’ll Do 1. Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements that enhance quality, efficiency, and sustainability across production areas. 2. Support new product introductions and manufacturing improvement initiatives by collaborating with engineering, welding, assembly, and machining teams. 3. Apply lean manufacturing principles—including Just-In-Time (JIT) production and Kaizen events—to reduce waste and improve flow. 4. Document and analyze current and future state processes using tools such as value stream mapping and standard work documentation. 5. Help design and optimize tooling and fixtures, and gain exposure to digital work instruction platforms. 6. Contribute to documentation and change management using Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Engineering Change Notification (ECN) systems such as Teamcenter or Windchill. 7. Participate in data-driven decision-making using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, Power BI dashboards, and Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled process monitoring tools. What We’re Looking For - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or a related field. - Foundational understanding of lean manufacturing concepts, tooling design, and process improvement techniques. - Ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic schematics. - Familiarity with JIT manufacturing, statistical process variation, and digital manufacturing tools is a plus. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a growth mindset. - Willingness to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Travel - Occasional travel is expected of this position. Work Location ONSITE: A team member’s day-to-day work is best done on a Vermeer campus. If work content can be occasionally completed at an offsite location, discuss potential arrangements with your manager. Equal Opportunity Employer At Vermeer Corporation, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background, and experiences. jobs.title: Edison Works Engineering Intern - US - Signature Design & Test - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Job Description Summary Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Job Description Help invent the future of flight, lift people up, and bring them home safely as a GE Aerospace Edison Works intern or co-op! At GE Aerospace, safety and quality are our top priorities — and in Edison Works, you’ll apply them while working at the forefront of advanced aerospace innovation. As part of this team, you’ll take on challenging, real-world engineering problems focused on developing next-generation propulsion technologies for critical military applications. You’ll build professional and technical skills through hands-on experience, mentorship, and training, while forming connections with fellow interns, engineers, and leaders. This experience will help prepare you for a potential full-time career at GE Aerospace, whether through one of our leadership programs or direct-hire opportunities. In Advanced Programs Signature Design & Test, you will help pioneer next-generation military propulsion systems by defining and delivering integrated survivability solutions to defend freedom around the globe. You will have the opportunity to participate in computational predictions, RCS testing, and analysis support activities to meet the capability needs of our customers. As a signature design engineer, you will gain experience building CAD models within NX or Patran, meshing those models, and then analyzing and post-processing the models with either SENTRi (Government provided computational electromagnetic code) or one of our many internally developed GE Computational Electromagnetic (CEM) codes. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with aero, mechanical, thermal, and performance engineers to achieve optimum designs as you plan and execute electromagnetic characterization and radar cross section measurements with industry expert mentors. Qualifications/Requirements: Minimum 3.0 cumulative G.P.A. on a 4.0 scale without rounding Attending a full-time registered and nationally accredited bachelor or graduate program (accepted majors are listed below) Reliable transportation, as many of our sites do not have public transportation available Due to the nature of the duties of this position, this role requires the individual to have an active security clearance at the SECRET level. Degrees accepted: Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering Ceramic Engineering Chemical Engineering Computer Engineering Computer Science Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Computer Engineering Materials Science/Engineering Mechanical Engineering Or any relevant or similar major to the ones above Eligibility Requirements: Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen. United States Citizenship required as a prerequisite for secret clearance. Desired Characteristics: Engineering aptitude and passion for aerospace technology An analytical approach to problem solving Strong knowledge of computer and Microsoft products Proficiency in at least one programming language Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with honesty, contributes constructively Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed, and takes initiative Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, and collaborative teamwork Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenge existing processes, critical thinker Benefits: Pay rates for this position begin at $20/hour and increase for each undergraduate year completed. Relocation support and housing assistance is available for those who relocate to a new city. jobs.body: About Pierce, an Oshkosh company At Pierce Manufacturing, we build trucks that protect people and communities around the world. jobs.title: US Advanced Manufacturing Equipment Engineering Intern, Sophomore (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com. Internship Program Overview: Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you will experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. Summary of Role: Our Fab 9 location in Essex Junction, VT is looking to hire Equipment Engineer Interns who are in pursuit of and have completed their first year in a 4-Year Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or other relevant discipline to sustain and run the fab floor with primary responsibility of resolving equipment and process issues. You will be given an intern project that will require you lead the project to completion and share your success through an end of year intern poster session. Essential Responsibilities include: Drive continuous improvement efforts in support of throughput improvement, cost reduction, and yield learning. Define and maintain equipment installation process qualification or installation roadmaps Define and maintain equipment installation roadmaps - Drive equipment planning, equipment selection and configuration with the area process engineers, including installation, start up and volume ramp of process equipment. Design, execute, and analyze experiments to screen and optimize equipment to meet technology (performance, yield, and reliability) and manufacturing (process stability, cost of ownership) targets. Must be mechanically inclined and able to lead hands on, tactical troubleshooting efforts to resolve long term performance issues; must be able to deconstruct and understand complex systems Collaborate with GLOBALFOUNDRIES integration and process engineering to support development of improved next generation technologies. Support technology transfer to other fabricators. Other Responsibilities: Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements, and programs. Required Qualifications: Education – A sophomore at the time of application and actively pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship. Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and be in good academic standing. Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal) Travel - Up to 10% Ability to work at least 40 hours per week during the internship. Preferred Qualifications: Prior related internship or co-op experience Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. Strong written and verbal communication skills Strong planning & organizational skills Knowledge of Semiconductor Manufacturing Knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiments (DOE) Ability to work effectively and efficiently with diverse teams, customers, internal and external partners. #InternshipProgramUS Expected Salary Range: $20.00 - $40.00 per hour Expected Salary Range $0.00 - $0.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. jobs.title: Quality Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Who We Are Vermeer equips customers doing important work around the world. We are global, driven by innovation and growing. The equipment we make manages natural resources, connects people and feeds and fuels communities. We live out a caring culture, we demonstrate agility, we keep a focus on customers and are stewards of our resources. These beliefs drive our culture, determine how we treat others and steer our business. Work Shift 1 - First Shift Job Summary Are you energized by solving problems and improving how things are made? As a Quality Engineer Intern at Vermeer, you’ll support real-world projects that enhance production processes and drive operational excellence. This internship offers hands-on experience in monitoring, analyzing, problem solving, and improving product performance—preparing you for a full-time engineering role upon graduation. What You’ll Do 1. Review and analyze internal and external quality performance for whole goods, upstream production, plant quality, and/or supplier quality; communicate trends and findings to manufacturing leadership. 2. Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) and problem-solving activities for assigned issues; help implement solutions to reduce quality issues and defects. 3. Assist in executing and auditing control plans and manufacturing processes for compliance and effectiveness; partner with manufacturing engineering to implement mistake-proofing and process improvements. 4. Collaborate with suppliers to problem-solve and verify quality improvements. 5. Participate in process capability studies and continuous improvement activities with process engineering, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods such as Process Capability Index (CPK) and control charts using statistical software such as Minitab (or similar). 6. Support critical Quality Management System (QMS) processes and participate in quality improvement projects and teams. What We’re Looking For - High School diploma required. Current student pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. - Awareness of quality tools and techniques, such as Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Core Tools, SPC methods, and CPK, with exposure to statistical software such as Minitab (or similar). - Awareness of lean manufacturing principles and using Lean Sigma/Six Sigma methodology to improve quality, including Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control (DMAIC). - Experience with troubleshooting and root cause analysis; exposure to Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Eight Disciplines (8D) problem solving preferred. - Ability to work in a team environment, operate assembly and measurement tools and devices, and read prints and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T). Travel - No travel is expected of this position. Work Location ONSITE: A team member’s day-to-day work is best done on a Vermeer campus. If work content can be occasionally completed at an offsite location, discuss potential arrangements with your manager. Equal Opportunity Employer At Vermeer Corporation, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status or any other status protected by the law. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact Team Member Solutions at (641) 621-8767 or at hr@vermeer.com . Interested? We’d love to get to know you.

jobs.title: Mechanical/Thermal Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Vertiv designs, builds and services critical infrastructure that enables vital applications for data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities. We support today’s growing mobile and cloud computing markets with a portfolio of power, thermal and infrastructure management solutions. We offer unsurpassed global scale and broad expertise, built from our heritage as Emerson Network Power. And now as Vertiv, we match industry leadership with the focus and spirit of a startup. Responsibilities 1) Support the Lead Mechanical Engineer (ME) to provide conceptual and detailed design of all HVAC and ventilation systems.. 2) Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes. 3) Create designs which meet or exceed Vertiv quality requirements and fall within budgetary requirements. 4) Review and approve mechanical product submittals. 5) Provide a detailed Schematic Design(SD), Detail Design(DD) and Construction Drawing(CD) narrative for HVAC design aspects of the solution 6) Thermal transfer calculations (fire ratings and thermal bridges) 7) Simple CFD analysis 8) Support contracted integration companies in regards to mechanical systems integration and the creation of integration drawings. 9) General layout drawings for all mechanical systems 10) Material specification – ductwork, cable management systems including cable tray, Fiber Management systems, wireway, busway, etc. 11) Work with Vertiv’s business units, Business Partners and preferred vendors to specify the appropriate mechanical equipment including cooling system components, cable management systems, fire suppression piping and other mechanical components. 12) Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to and during construction phases. 13) Quality control during integration of mechanical systems 14) Support for all on site integration support Other duties as assigned Desired Qualifications 1) Seeking Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering with a thermal background or acceptable experience 2) Working knowledge in AutoDesk suite of Engineering software including AutoCAD and Revit is preferred 3) Proven experience with Microsoft Office Applications 4) Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and equipment specifications 5) Must be able to clearly interpret customer specification requirements. 6) Ability to research new designs, technologies and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities 7) Ability to think outside the box to find creative and innovative solutions to reduce costs with no impact on quality, reliability or maintainability. 8) Must possess excellent communication skills both written and verbal. 9) Detail oriented. Desired Software Skills Requirements · AutoDesk AutoCAD · Revit · 6Sigma (CFD Software) · Microsoft Office Desired Area of Study · Mechanical Engineering POSITION ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: · This position can be based in Lorain, OH or Delaware, OH #LI-RB1

jobs.title: GE Vernova - GridOS Project Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Job Description Summary Job Description Role Overview: We are looking for a motivated Electrical or Computer Engineering intern to join our team, focusing on the evaluation and validation of next-generation Distribution Management System (DMS) applications. In this role, you will play a key part in bridging the gap between innovative software development and real-world grid operations. You will evaluate new applications, ensure they meet industry deployment standards, identify technical defects, and help educate our user base. Key Responsibilities: Application Evaluation: Perform hands-on testing of new Distribution Management applications to assess their functionality, reliability, and integration capabilities within our existing power system environments. Test Development: Design and build comprehensive test cases to validate application performance, edge cases, and user requirements, ensuring all new features meet rigorous quality standards. Deployment Feasibility: Analyze software requirements to determine if new applications can be deployed using standard industry tooling, specifically leveraging GitOps principles and ArgoCD for automated deployments within Linux-based environments . Quality Assurance & Debugging: Actively "stress test" new products by identifying, documenting, and tracking bugs. You will work closely with development teams to verify fixes and ensure a seamless end-user experience. Technical Documentation: Translate complex software features into user-friendly training materials, including technical guides, how-to videos, and internal knowledge-base articles to assist grid operators and engineers. Required Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Fundamental understanding of electric power distribution systems. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a passion for software quality. Excellent technical writing and communication skills; ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences. Technical Skills & Tooling: Operating Systems: Proficiency in Linux (command-line navigation, shell scripting, and system troubleshooting). Programming: Proficiency or strong interest in C# . CI/CD & DevOps: Familiarity with Jenkins for continuous integration and pipeline automation. Artifact Management: Experience with Nexus for managing software components and dependencies. Deployment: Exposure to or willingness to learn GitOps workflows and ArgoCD for Kubernetes-native deployment management.
